contentRules.deleteDesc: New scan results are no longer matched with it. What it already found stays.

contentRules.emptyDescription: Platform rules already run on every scan. Add a rule to recognize a product of your own or a key format only your organization uses.

contentRules.noWrite: You need the scans:content:write permission to change detection rules

contentRules.platform.description: Curated by the platform and updated with it. Every scan result is matched with them and with your rules.
contentRules.platform.none: No platform rule pack is installed yet.
contentRules.platform.title: Platform rules

contentRules.yours.description: Name your own products, or find your own key formats and internal names. They apply to your organization only.
